title.zh: GS-1 升到 2.1.9、依赖改指 GitHub，和弦扫描提速
title.en: GS-1 2.1.9 from GitHub, and a faster chord scan

highlights.zh: GS-1 依赖改为从 GitHub（gradetwo/synth）取源并支持 --ref 固定版本；vendored 核心升到 2.1.9（ABI 9），25 项契约校验通过、音符路径零分配。
highlights.en: The GS-1 dependency now sources from GitHub (gradetwo/synth) with --ref pinning; the vendored core is 2.1.9 (ABI 9), 25 contract checks green, zero allocations on the note path.

highlights.zh: patternHealth 和弦扫描由逐音符重扫改为单趟索引：4096 音符 337→2.2 ms，并修正堆叠起音点造成的和弦身份差异。
highlights.en: patternHealth's chord scan is one indexed pass instead of a per-note rescan: 4096 notes 337 to 2.2 ms, and the stacked-onset identity divergence is fixed.
